item.title: StupidMirror 0.7.4
item.description:
• Show Refresh Thumbnail and Remove Device directly in the device toolbar, beside the control and mirror buttons. Removing a device still asks for confirmation, and refreshing stays disabled while the device is disconnected.
  • Give Android previews a rounded screen shell with a slim metallic rim, side keys, and a subtle shadow. The dashboard, mirror window, and AI client previews share the same shell, preserving the screen's aspect ratio and touch-coordinate mapping in portrait and landscape.
